papers.abs_cn: 通用服务机器人需要能够在陌生环境中处理多样化人类请求的导航系统，同时兼顾任务通用性和场景通用性。一些现有方法通过微调多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）来预测导航动作，使其行为依赖于导航训练数据的覆盖范围，并可能限制对新请求和新环境的泛化能力。我们的核心洞察是让 MLLM 专注于解读请求、理解场景和做出决策，同时保留其通用能力，并将运动执行委托给导航工具。为实现这一思路，我们提出了 SuperNav，它为预训练的 MLLM 配备了一套专门的智能体框架，而无需对 MLLM 进行导航特定的微调。我们的框架通过导航技能（Navigation Skills）、面向智能体的物理交互工具（Tools），以及任务进度与上下文管理来支持这些决策。统一的视觉点接口将决策与运动连接起来，允许模型直接在图像中指定目的地，并根据执行反馈修正其决策。这些组件共同支持在不同任务需求和环境中持续导航。SuperNav 在实例级、多物体和需求驱动任务上优于四个被评估的基线。在 HM3D 上的类别级评估以及在真实四足机器人上的部署进一步证明了其跨环境的适用性。项目页面：https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav/

papers.title: Use and Disuse: Intent-Structured Experience Consolidation for Memory and Learning in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: The evolution of Large Language Model agents from single-task execution to long-term autonomous operation highlights the critical challenge of transforming continuous experiences into reusable knowledge. To address this, we propose Hippocam, a hierarchical memory and continual learning architecture. Hippocam draws inspiration from two characteristics of human memory: cognitive processes selectively maintain information relevant to current goals, while long-term memories form gradually through repeated consolidation. Accordingly, Hippocam structures an agent's ongoing work as nested intents. The active context remains centered on the current intent, while completed intents are consolidated into the task-relevant outcomes and state needed for subsequent work, rather than carrying forward their full working details. Concurrently, a recursive prefix consolidation mechanism repeatedly consolidates earlier history, causing long-unused experiences to become increasingly abstract. Original interactions are preserved, allowing the agent to progressively recover finer-grained details through the hierarchy and stop once sufficient information is available. Crucially, when past experiences are recalled and reintegrated into active work, they undergo subsequent consolidation alongside new experiences, thereby being reinforced, supplemented, and updated. Through this memory dynamic of use and disuse, Hippocam connects working context, long-term memory, knowledge accumulation, and skill learning within a single continuously evolving experiential process. This enables agents to learn and evolve capabilities through their own experiences without parameter updates.
papers.title_cn: 用进废退：面向LLM智能体记忆与学习的意图结构化经验巩固
papers.abs_cn: 大型语言模型智能体从单任务执行向长期自主运行的演进，凸显了将连续经验转化为可复用知识这一关键挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Hippocam，一种分层记忆与持续学习架构。Hippocam的灵感来自人类记忆的两个特征：认知过程会选择性地保留与当前目标相关的信息，而长期记忆则通过反复巩固逐渐形成。据此，Hippocam将智能体正在进行的工作结构化为嵌套意图。活跃上下文始终以当前意图为中心，而已完成的意图则被巩固为后续工作所需的任务相关结果和状态，而不是继续携带其完整的工作细节。同时，递归前缀巩固机制会反复巩固较早的历史，使长期未被使用的经验变得越来越抽象。原始交互被保留下来，使智能体能够通过该层级逐步恢复更细粒度的细节，并在信息足够时停止。关键在于，当过去经验被回忆并重新整合到活跃工作中时，它们会与新的经验一起经历后续巩固，从而得到强化、补充和更新。通过这种用进废退的记忆动态，Hippocam将工作上下文、长期记忆、知识积累和技能学习连接在一个持续演化的单一经验过程中。这使智能体无需更新参数即可通过自身经验学习和演化能力。

papers.title: Using Weisfeiler-Leman Features for Algorithm Selection in Constraint Optimisation
papers.abstract: Algorithm Selection is essential for efficient Constraint Programming. Over the years, many algorithm selectors based on machine learning methods have been successfully applied, yet traditional feature extraction methods often rely on manually decided instance-level statistics that fail to capture the underlying problem structure. In this paper we aim to bridge this gap by introducing a novel, automated feature extraction methodology that integrates graph conversion and Weisfeiler-Lehman graph kernels to generate robust structural representations of problem instances. The 1-WL test bounds the graph-distinguishing power of standard message-passing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), and suitable GNN architectures match this bound \citep{Xuetal2018}. WL-based features offer an alternative that does not require training a GNN. Our primary contribution is a cut-based representation (\texttt{WLc}) designed to model structural partitions and provide a more nuanced predictive signal. We evaluate our approach on instances from the 2023--2025 MiniZinc Challenges across two tasks: maximizing Borda count scores and maximizing predictive accuracy. Experimental results across Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, and Multi-Layer Perceptrons demonstrate that cut-based features outperform \texttt{fzn2feat} with SVMs, while results with RFs and MLPs are closer.
papers.title_cn: 使用Weisfeiler-Leman特征进行约束优化中的算法选择
papers.abs_cn: 算法选择对于高效的约束编程至关重要。多年来，许多基于机器学习方法的算法选择器已被成功应用，然而传统的特征提取方法往往依赖于人工决定的实例级统计量，无法捕捉底层问题结构。在本文中，我们旨在弥合这一差距，引入一种新颖的自动化特征提取方法，该方法整合了图转换和Weisfeiler-Lehman图核，以生成问题实例的鲁棒结构化表示。1-WL测试界定了标准消息传递图神经网络（GNN）的图区分能力，而合适的GNN架构能够达到这一界限\citep{Xuetal2018}。基于WL的特征提供了一种无需训练GNN的替代方案。我们的主要贡献是一种基于割的表示（\texttt{WLc}），旨在建模结构划分并提供更细致的预测信号。我们在2023--2025年MiniZinc挑战赛的实例上评估了我们的方法，涵盖两个任务：最大化Borda计分和最大化预测准确率。在支持向量机、随机森林和多层感知机上的实验结果表明，基于割的特征在使用SVM时优于\texttt{fzn2feat}，而在使用RF和MLP时结果较为接近。

papers.title: A persistent accuracy ceiling in automated verbal deception detection
papers.abstract: Automated methods have been proposed to overcome the limitations of human verbal deception detection, but evidence remains fragmented across disciplines. We systematically reviewed 25 years of research (289 reports, 6,136 classification models) and meta-analyzed 3,653 models nested within 97 datasets. Pooled accuracy was 74.4% (95% CI: 71.2%-77.4%) with substantial heterogeneity. Accuracy was driven by methodological quality (ground truth, data source, class balance, evaluation procedure) more than by model complexity: the adoption of embeddings and large language models has not translated into improved predictive performance. Only 12.46% of reports used data with verifiable ground-truth, and only 23.96% of models were evaluated on independent data. The pooled accuracy aligns with meta-analyses of manual approaches, suggesting a ceiling of 70-75%, unlikely to be lifted by current research conventions.
papers.title_cn: 自动化言语欺骗检测中持续存在的准确率上限
papers.abs_cn: 已有研究提出用自动化方法克服人类言语欺骗检测的局限，但相关证据在不同学科间仍较为零散。我们系统回顾了25年的研究（289篇报告，6,136个分类模型），并对嵌套于97个数据集中的3,653个模型进行了元分析。合并准确率为74.4%（95% CI：71.2%-77.4%），异质性较大。准确率更多由方法学质量（真实标签、数据来源、类别平衡、评估程序）驱动，而非模型复杂度：采用embedding和large language model并未转化为预测性能的提升。仅有12.46%的报告使用了具有可验证真实标签的数据，仅有23.96%的模型在独立数据上进行了评估。该合并准确率与人工方法的元分析结果一致，提示存在70-75%的上限，且当前研究惯例不太可能突破这一上限。

papers.title: Credal Machine Learning for Risk-Averse Decision Making
papers.abstract: In many machine learning applications, it is necessary to guard against worst-case scenarios and predictions that could result in substantial losses. In principle, this can be achieved by training risk-averse predictive models that minimize loss functions such as conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), rather than relying on models that perform well on average. In practice, however, the effectiveness of this approach to risk aversion is undermined by the learner's uncertainty regarding the true loss distribution and, consequently, the true CVaR. To achieve reliable risk-aversion, we propose a method in which this (epistemic) uncertainty is represented in terms of credal sets, i.e., sets of probability distributions. More specifically, we develop an efficient yet reliable learner that produces predictions in the form of credal sets and combine it with a novel decision rule that maps each credal set to a single predictive distribution for CVaR minimization. Across classification, under distribution shift, and in reinforcement learning, our approach reliably avoids catastrophic decisions, while sacrificing little in expected performance.
papers.title_cn: 面向风险规避决策的信度机器学习
papers.abs_cn: 在许多机器学习应用中，有必要防范可能导致重大损失的最坏情况和预测。原则上，这可以通过训练风险规避的预测模型来实现，这些模型最小化诸如条件风险价值（CVaR）之类的损失函数，而不是依赖于平均表现良好的模型。然而在实践中，这种风险规避方法的有效性受到学习者对真实损失分布以及因此对真实CVaR的不确定性的削弱。为了实现可靠的风险规避，我们提出了一种方法，其中这种（认知）不确定性以信度集（即概率分布的集合）来表示。更具体地说，我们开发了一种高效且可靠的学习器，它以信度集的形式产生预测，并将其与一种新颖的决策规则相结合，该规则将每个信度集映射到用于CVaR最小化的单一预测分布。在分类、分布偏移和强化学习中，我们的方法可靠地避免了灾难性决策，同时在期望性能上牺牲很少。

papers.title: Universal Textual Teaching for LLMs
papers.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from stronger Teacher models to weaker Student models, but most methods require training the Student parameters, thereby binding the distilled knowledge to a specific architecture and checkpoint. This implicit representation is difficult to interpret or reuse across models and limits KD for API-only or costly-to-train models. This paper studies knowledge transfer for large language models (LLMs). We introduce Universal Textual Teaching (UTT), a parameter-update-free framework that distills observed Teacher-Student knowledge gaps into a textual, interpretable, and reusable natural-language artifact called Primer. Specifically, UTT first identifies representative gap cases through paired evaluations, and iteratively updates the Primer via multi-role interactions: the Student attempts each task, the Prompter turns evaluation feedback into a teaching instruction, the Teacher provides a targeted demonstration, and the Synthesizer consolidates validated lessons. Empirically, on the challenging math (Omni-MATH-2) and code generation (KernelBench) tasks, extensive results confirm the effectiveness of the method: UTT remarkably raises the Student's accuracy from 9.4% to 48.6% and Fast1 accuracy from 9% to 35% on KernelBench, while increasing mathematical reasoning accuracy from 27.6% to 51.7%. UTT also performs better than representative prompt engineering and parameter-based KD methods. Of note, UTT is shown to be generalizable across different Teachers and Students: a Primer synthesized for one Teacher-Student pair can generalize to other Students that do not participate in the synthesis.
papers.title_cn: 面向LLM的通用文本教学
papers.abs_cn: 知识蒸馏（KD）将知识从更强的Teacher模型迁移到更弱的Student模型，但大多数方法需要训练Student参数，从而将蒸馏出的知识绑定到特定架构和检查点。这种隐式表示难以解释，也难以在不同模型间复用，并限制了KD在仅API可用或训练成本高昂的模型上的应用。本文研究大语言模型（LLM）的知识迁移。我们提出通用文本教学（UTT），一种无需参数更新的框架，它将观察到的Teacher-Student知识差距蒸馏为一个文本化、可解释且可复用的自然语言产物，称为Primer。具体而言，UTT首先通过配对评估识别代表性差距案例，并通过多角色交互迭代更新Primer：Student尝试每个任务，Prompter将评估反馈转化为教学指令，Teacher提供针对性示范，Synthesizer整合经过验证的经验。在实证上，在具有挑战性的数学（Omni-MATH-2）和代码生成（KernelBench）任务上，大量结果证实了该方法的有效性：UTT显著将Student在KernelBench上的准确率从9.4%提升到48.6%，Fast1准确率从9%提升到35%，同时将数学推理准确率从27.6%提升到51.7%。UTT也优于代表性的提示工程和基于参数的KD方法。值得注意的是，UTT被证明可跨不同Teacher和Student泛化：为一个Teacher-Student对合成的Primer可以泛化到未参与合成的其他Student。

papers.title: A Geometric Approach to Soft Actor-Critic with Zonotopes for Locomotion Learning
papers.abstract: Off-policy actor--critic methods control overestimation bias by taking the minimum of two critics. This uses the same aggregation rule everywhere, regardless of how the critics disagree. We propose \textbf{GeZo-SAC}, which uses auxiliary geometric representations to adapt critic pessimism to the state and action. Alongside its scalar value, each critic predicts a set of generators defining a zonotope. Probing this zonotope along sampled directions provides a geometric width, "subtracted from each critic value as a pessimistic offset, and a measure of disagreement between the two critics, aggregated with log-sum-exp. This disagreement controls how the critics are combined, moving from a width-weighted average toward the usual minimum as disagreement increases. At inference, the deployed policy is an unmodified SAC actor, since the generators are used only on the critic side during training.Across four MuJoCo-v5 locomotion benchmarks and six off-policy baselines, GeZo-SAC achieves the highest mean return on Ant-v5 and Hopper-v5 and remains competitive with other methods on the remaining tasks. Our analysis further shows that GeZo-SAC achieves the lowest average actuator work and action effort per metre among the evaluated methods, while maintaining near-zero measured overestimation frequency across all four environments.
papers.title_cn: 一种使用 Zonotope 的软演员-评论家几何方法用于运动学习
papers.abs_cn: 离策略演员-评论家方法通过取两个评论家的最小值来控制高估偏差。这种方法在所有地方都使用相同的聚合规则，而不管评论家之间的分歧如何。我们提出了 GeZo-SAC，它使用辅助几何表示来使评论家的悲观程度适应状态和动作。除了标量值之外，每个评论家还预测一组定义 zonotope 的生成元。沿采样方向探测该 zonotope 可提供一个几何宽度，该宽度从每个评论家值中减去作为悲观偏移，并提供两个评论家之间分歧的度量，用 log-sum-exp 聚合。这种分歧控制评论家的组合方式，随着分歧增加，从宽度加权平均转向通常的最小值。在推理时，部署的策略是未经修改的 SAC 演员，因为生成元仅在训练期间用于评论家一侧。在四个 MuJoCo-v5 运动基准和六个离策略基线中，GeZo-SAC 在 Ant-v5 和 Hopper-v5 上取得了最高的平均回报，并在其余任务上与其他方法保持竞争力。我们的分析进一步表明，在所评估的方法中，GeZo-SAC 实现了最低的平均执行器功和每米动作努力，同时在所有四个环境中保持接近零的测量高估频率。

papers.title: RAPID-DNN: Reliability-Aware Partitioning for Robust DNN Inference Deployment on Edge AI
papers.abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) deployed on heterogeneous edge accelerators are increasingly exposed to runtime hardware faults. Tight power and resource budgets push these platforms toward aggressive voltage scaling and limit the use of hardware fault mitigation, while process variation, thermal stress, and device aging raise fault rates further. The resulting transient bit level corruptions propagate through inference and can sharply reduce prediction accuracy. Existing DNN partitioning frameworks optimize latency and energy under fault free assumptions, so their deployment strategies often fail to sustain reliable inference in realistic operating conditions. This paper presents RAPID DNN, a reliability aware partitioning framework that adds runtime reliability as a third optimization objective alongside latency and energy. RAPID DNN first characterizes layer wise reliability through systematic fault injection in the weight and activation domains to identify vulnerability critical layers. The resulting sensitivity profile guides a three objective NSGA II optimizer that jointly minimizes inference latency, energy consumption, and expected fault induced accuracy degradation. We evaluate RAPID DNN on AlexNet, SqueezeNet, ResNet18, VGG16, and MobileNetV2 using heterogeneous Eyeriss and SIMBA accelerator profiles. Across fault models and injection probabilities, it consistently improves inference robustness over the fault agnostic baseline. Under the representative mixed random fault configuration, RAPID DNN raises average Top 1 accuracy by 9.81 percentage points and reduces average expected fault induced accuracy degradation by 36.86%, at a cost of 2.38% average latency overhead and 3.34% average energy overhead. These results show that treating reliability as a partitioning objective enables robust DNN deployment on heterogeneous edge accelerators under runtime hardware faults.
papers.title_cn: RAPID-DNN：面向边缘AI上鲁棒DNN推理部署的可靠性感知划分
papers.abs_cn: 部署在异构边缘加速器上的深度神经网络（DNN）日益暴露于运行时硬件故障。紧张的功耗和资源预算推动这些平台采用激进的电压缩放，并限制了硬件故障缓解措施的使用，而工艺偏差、热应力和器件老化进一步提高了故障率。由此产生的瞬态位级损坏会在推理过程中传播，并可能急剧降低预测精度。现有的DNN划分框架在无故障假设下优化延迟和能耗，因此其部署策略往往无法在现实运行条件下维持可靠推理。本文提出RAPID-DNN，一种可靠性感知划分框架，将运行时可靠性作为继延迟和能耗之后的第三个优化目标。RAPID-DNN首先通过在权重域和激活域中进行系统性故障注入来刻画逐层可靠性，以识别脆弱关键层。由此得到的敏感度剖面指导一个三目标NSGA-II优化器，联合最小化推理延迟、能耗和预期故障导致的精度退化。我们在AlexNet、SqueezeNet、ResNet18、VGG16和MobileNetV2上，使用异构Eyeriss和SIMBA加速器配置对RAPID-DNN进行评估。在多种故障模型和注入概率下，它始终优于故障不可知基线，提高了推理鲁棒性。在具有代表性的混合随机故障配置下，RAPID-DNN将平均Top-1精度提高9.81个百分点，并将平均预期故障导致精度退化降低36.86%，代价是2.38%的平均延迟开销和3.34%的平均能耗开销。这些结果表明，将可靠性作为划分目标，能够在运行时硬件故障下实现异构边缘加速器上的鲁棒DNN部署。

papers.title: Adaptive dynamic programming using Lyapunov function constraints
papers.abstract: This work is concerned with a stabilizing adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) approach to approximate solution of a given infinite-horizon optimal control problem. Since the latter problem cannot, in general, be solved exactly, a parametrized function approximator for the infinite-horizon cost function is introduced in ADP (so called ``critic''). This critic is used to adapt the parameters of the function approximator. The so called ``actor'' in turn derives the optimal input of the system. It is a notoriously hard problem to guarantee closed-loop stability of ADP due to the use of approximation structures in the control scheme. Since at least stabilizability is always assumed in the analyses of ADP, it is justified to invoke a respective Lyapunov function. The proposed ADP scheme explicitly uses the said Lyapunov function to simultaneously optimize the critic and guarantee closed-loop stability. A Hessian-free optimization routine is utilized for the actor and critic optimization problems. Convergence to prescribed vicinities of the optima is shown. A computational study showed significant performance improvement for the critic-based approach compared a nominal stabilizing controller for a range of initial conditions.
papers.title_cn: 使用 Lyapunov 函数约束的自适应动态规划
papers.abs_cn: 本文研究了一种稳定的自适应动态规划（ADP）方法，用于近似求解给定的无限时域最优控制问题。由于后者通常无法精确求解，因此在 ADP 中引入了无限时域代价函数的参数化函数逼近器（即所谓的“critic”）。该 critic 用于自适应调整函数逼近器的参数。而所谓的“actor”则用于推导系统的最优输入。由于控制方案中使用了逼近结构，保证 ADP 的闭环稳定性是一个众所周知的难题。由于在 ADP 的分析中至少总是假设可稳定性，因此调用相应的 Lyapunov 函数是合理的。所提出的 ADP 方案显式地使用上述 Lyapunov 函数来同时优化 critic 并保证闭环稳定性。针对 actor 和 critic 优化问题，采用了一种无 Hessian 的优化方法。证明了收敛到最优值的规定邻域。一项计算研究表明，对于一系列初始条件，基于 critic 的方法相比标称稳定控制器具有显著的性能提升。

papers.title: ContourVLA: A Closed-Loop Perception-Action Contour Policy for Generalized Referring Expression Segmentation
papers.abstract: Generalized referring expression segmentation (GRES) requires dynamically balancing high-level semantics for identifying a variable number of language-specified referents with fine-grained visual evidence for precise boundary delineation. This requirement challenges existing cascaded vision-language architectures, which typically rely on static feature interfaces and single-pass mask prediction, limiting adaptive perception and geometric correction. We introduce ContourVLA, a vision-language-action policy that recasts GRES as a closed-loop visuomotor process, in which editable contours serve as explicit policy states that condition multimodal perception and are updated by geometric action chunks. Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling (EASS) couples contour-guided bidirectional boundary sampling with state-conditioned routing of multilevel multimodal features, adapting perception to each contour state. Following supervised initialization, Dustbin-Augmented Entropic Credit Transport GRPO (DECT-GRPO) jointly optimizes discrete grounding and continuous contour actions with instance-level credits. Its rollout rewards and credits are derived from soft prediction-target correspondences that account for false positives and missed targets. ContourVLA improves gIoU over the strongest evaluated baselines by 8.7, 2.8, and 2.7 points on gRefCOCO val, testA, and testB, respectively, and achieves the highest mIoU across all eight RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg splits.
papers.title_cn: ContourVLA：面向广义指代分割的闭环感知-动作轮廓策略
papers.abs_cn: 广义指代分割（GRES）要求动态平衡高层语义以识别数量可变的语言指定指代对象，同时利用细粒度视觉证据进行精确边界描绘。这一需求对现有的级联视觉-语言架构构成了挑战，后者通常依赖静态特征接口和单次掩码预测，限制了自适应感知和几何校正能力。我们提出 ContourVLA，一种视觉-语言-动作策略，将 GRES 重新构建为闭环视觉运动过程，其中可编辑轮廓作为显式策略状态，条件化多模态感知并由几何动作块更新。演化感知语义调度（EASS）将轮廓引导的双向边界采样与状态条件化的多层级多模态特征路由相结合，使感知适应每个轮廓状态。在监督初始化之后，Dustbin 增强熵信用传输 GRPO（DECT-GRPO）以实例级信用联合优化离散定位和连续轮廓动作。其 rollout 奖励和信用来源于考虑假阳性和漏检目标的软预测-目标对应关系。ContourVLA 在 gRefCOCO val、testA 和 testB 上分别将 gIoU 较最强评估基线提升了 8.7、2.8 和 2.7 个百分点，并在全部八个 RefCOCO、RefCOCO+ 和 RefCOCOg 划分上取得了最高 mIoU。

papers.title: Could LLM Watermark Detection be Public?
papers.abstract: Watermarking large language models is popular for tracing chatbot and agentic outputs, yet detectors remain unreleased since exposing them could let attackers do targeted edits with the detector's feedback. However, watermarks are already vulnerable to uninformed tampering attacks. We thus first quantify whether a public detector would be an additional liability in a deployment setting at varying levels of access, from token-level scores to a binary verdict. Second, we introduce a split-key public-private watermarking method that exposes one key through a public detector while keeping the other for full verification and forensics. An informed attacker can only move the public signal, creating an imbalance between public and private scores. We introduce a statistical test for this imbalance, and combine it with the full key verdict in a two-stage mechanism. Third, we evaluate the split-key method on a wide range of removal and forgery attacks, comparing the uninformed to detector-informed settings. Public detection improves removal only at small edit budgets, since plain rephrasing already strips the watermark at a lower quality cost, but it does enable forgery, which the private pipeline can identify. Overall, releasing half of the watermark enables transparency and interoperability, and tampering with the released half stays detectable. This bounds the provider's liability and questions the need to keep detectors fully private.
papers.title_cn: LLM 水印检测可以公开吗？
papers.abs_cn: 对大型语言模型进行水印嵌入已被广泛用于追踪聊天机器人和智能体输出，但检测器仍未公开，因为暴露检测器可能让攻击者借助检测器反馈进行定向编辑。然而，水印本就容易受到无信息篡改攻击。因此，我们首先量化在部署环境中，从 token 级分数到二元判定等不同访问级别下，公开检测器是否会成为额外的负担。其次，我们提出一种分裂密钥的公私水印方法，通过公开检测器暴露其中一个密钥，同时保留另一个密钥用于完整验证和取证。有信息攻击者只能移动公开信号，从而在公开分数与私有分数之间造成不平衡。我们引入一种针对这种不平衡的统计检验，并将其与完整密钥判定结合在一个两阶段机制中。第三，我们在广泛的移除和伪造攻击上评估分裂密钥方法，比较无信息设置与检测器知情设置。公开检测仅在小编辑预算下改善移除，因为简单改写已经以更低的质量成本剥离水印，但它确实使伪造成为可能，而私有流程可以识别伪造。总体而言，公开一半水印可实现透明性和互操作性，而对已公开那一半的篡改仍可被检测到。这限制了提供方的责任，并质疑了将检测器完全保密的必要性。

papers.title: VINCIE-NExT: Unlocking Video Editing from Images via In-Context Modeling
papers.abstract: Building a capable video editor remains significantly harder than a video generator: editing requires (source, instruction, edited) triplets that are prohibitively expensive to annotate and difficult to synthesize at scale, whereas image editing has already reached maturity with millions of such pairs readily available. In this work, we introduce VINCIE-NExT, a unified framework that transfers editing capability from images to videos through in-context visual demonstrations, alleviating the need for large-scale paired video editing data. VINCIE-NExT decomposes video editing into a structured chain of composable sub-tasks (Video -> Image -> Image -> Video), routing editing intent through the image domain and enabling scalable joint training from heterogeneous image and video corpora under a unified diffusion objective. An image editing pair, synthesized by the model or supplied by the user, is prepended as an in-context visual demonstration that serves as a spatial appearance blueprint for every output frame. To ground appearance edits across the interleaved context, we introduce a novel position encoding that links image demonstrations and video frames in a shared spatial coordinate system, enabling pixel-faithful propagation of appearance changes to every output frame. Chain-of-Editing further provides principled test-time scaling: by executing the sub-task chain as progressive diffusion stages, editing quality can be improved by investing additional compute without retraining. Comprehensive experiments on OpenVE-Bench demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance across diverse editing categories, with ablations confirming the effectiveness of each component.
papers.title_cn: VINCIE-NExT：通过上下文建模从图像解锁视频编辑
papers.abs_cn: 构建一个能力强的视频编辑器仍然比视频生成器困难得多：编辑需要（源、指令、编辑后）三元组，这些三元组的标注成本极高，且难以大规模合成，而图像编辑已经成熟，拥有数百万这样的配对可供使用。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 VINCIE-NExT，一个统一框架，通过上下文视觉演示将编辑能力从图像迁移到视频，从而减轻了对大规模配对视频编辑数据的需求。VINCIE-NExT 将视频编辑分解为结构化的一系列可组合子任务（Video -> Image -> Image -> Video），通过图像域路由编辑意图，并在统一的扩散目标下实现来自异构图像和视频语料库的可扩展联合训练。由模型合成或用户提供的图像编辑对，被前置为上下文视觉演示，作为每个输出帧的空间外观蓝图。为了在交错上下文中锚定外观编辑，我们引入了一种新颖的位置编码，将图像演示和视频帧链接在共享的空间坐标系中，使外观变化能够像素级忠实地传播到每个输出帧。Chain-of-Editing 进一步提供了有原则的测试时扩展：通过将子任务链作为渐进扩散阶段执行，可以通过投入额外计算而无需重新训练来提高编辑质量。在 OpenVE-Bench 上的全面实验展示了在多样化编辑类别中的最先进性能，消融实验证实了每个组件的有效性。

papers.title: Predefined-Time Integral Reinforcement Learning for Unknown Nonlinear Systems via Inverse-Optimal Design
papers.abstract: This paper develops a new predefined-time integral reinforcement learning framework for optimal control of unknown nonlinear systems. The unknown drift is first approximated by a radial basis function (RBF) neural network, together with a data-driven online identification law for updating the corresponding neural weights. After the identifier converges to a sufficiently small neighborhood of the true dynamics, the learned model is incorporated into the integral reinforcement learning (IRL) problem. Unlike conventional reinforcement-learning-based optimal control, the desired convergence time is introduced directly into the control objective: a Lyapunov function and its prescribed decay behavior are specified by the designer, and inverse-optimal control is then used to construct a compatible running cost whose optimal policy inherits the predefined-time stabilization property. The value function is approximated by a second RBF neural network, and a new critic update law is developed to impose predefined-time convergence on the critic weights. Finite informative learning data are stored in a replay buffer and reused during the critic update, thereby avoiding the need for persistent excitation throughout the closed-loop operation. Theoretical analysis proves that the critic-weight error enters a prescribed residual set within the allocated learning horizon, while the closed-loop state reaches a small neighborhood of the origin within the overall designer-specified deadline. Numerical simulations on an unknown nonlinear system verify accurate drift reconstruction, predefined-time critic learning, and closed-loop convergence.
papers.title_cn: 基于逆最优设计的未知非线性系统预定义时间积分强化学习
papers.abs_cn: 本文提出了一种新的预定义时间积分强化学习框架，用于未知非线性系统的最优控制。首先利用径向基函数（RBF）神经网络逼近未知漂移项，并结合数据驱动的在线辨识律更新相应的神经网络权重。当辨识器收敛到真实动态的足够小邻域后，将学习到的模型纳入积分强化学习（IRL）问题。与传统基于强化学习的最优控制不同，本文将期望的收敛时间直接引入控制目标：由设计者指定一个 Lyapunov 函数及其规定的衰减行为，然后利用逆最优控制构造一个兼容的运行代价，使其最优策略继承预定义时间镇定性质。值函数由第二个 RBF 神经网络逼近，并开发了一种新的评论家更新律，以对评论家权重施加预定义时间收敛。有限的信息学习数据存储在经验回放缓冲区中，并在评论家更新期间重复使用，从而避免了在整个闭环运行过程中需要持续激励。理论分析证明，评论家权重误差在分配的学习时限内进入规定的残差集，而闭环状态在整体设计者指定的截止时间内到达原点的小邻域。对未知非线性系统的数值仿真验证了漂移重构的准确性、预定义时间评论家学习和闭环收敛。

papers.title: Few-Step Generation via Data-Space Iteration
papers.abstract: Flow matching has emerged as a scalable paradigm for training high-quality generative models, but sampling from the learned probability flow requires many network evaluations. Distillation can reduce this cost to one or a few evaluations; however, one-step generation often sacrifices quality, making few-step generation the practical operating regime. Existing few-step methods perform their iterative computation along the probability flow and therefore require a fixed, manually chosen timestep discretization. This discretization is often chosen heuristically and is expensive to tune; it may also be restrictive when refinement difficulty differs across samples or spatial locations. We introduce data-space iteration, a few-step generation framework that removes flow discretization altogether. Starting from noise, a shared generator directly refines its prediction in data space, with every iteration trained to produce the best sample permitted by its capacity. Our formulation integrates with distribution matching distillation (DMD) with minimal changes, enabling a controlled comparison between iteration methods under matched training settings. On class-conditional ImageNet 256x256, data-space iteration outperforms standard discretization baselines and matches or improves upon variants selected through schedule search, without requiring schedule-specific training. These results show that data-space iteration provides a simple and effective alternative to discretized flow-space iteration for fast generation.
papers.title_cn: 通过数据空间迭代实现少步生成
papers.abs_cn: 流匹配已成为训练高质量生成模型的一种可扩展范式，但从学习到的概率流中采样需要大量网络评估。蒸馏可以将这一成本降低到一次或几次评估；然而，单步生成通常会牺牲质量，使得少步生成成为实际可用的工作区间。现有的少步方法沿概率流执行迭代计算，因此需要固定的、手动选择的时间步离散化。这种离散化通常是启发式选择的，且调优成本高昂；当不同样本或空间位置的细化难度不同时，它也可能带来限制。我们引入了数据空间迭代，这是一种完全消除流离散化的少步生成框架。从噪声出发，一个共享生成器直接在数据空间中细化其预测，每次迭代都被训练以产生其容量所允许的最佳样本。我们的公式以最小的改动与分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）相结合，使得在匹配的训练设置下能够对迭代方法进行受控比较。在类别条件 ImageNet 256x256 上，数据空间迭代优于标准离散化基线，并匹配或超过了通过调度搜索选出的变体，且不需要针对特定调度的训练。这些结果表明，数据空间迭代为快速生成提供了一种简单而有效的替代离散化流空间迭代的方案。

papers.title: SCORE: Spectral Correlation Estimation for Multivariate Gaussians
papers.abstract: Neural network-based predictive modeling with high-dimensional structured Gaussian targets requires an efficient and numerically stable, yet expressive approximation of the covariance matrix. We propose SCORE: a scalable framework, combining scoring rule training with an expressive covariance approximation learned in spectral space. For $d$-dimensional data, the learning task is decomposed into learning the marginal distributions and learning a structured correlation matrix, which enables dense dependencies with linear storage and $\mathcal{O}(d\log d)$ cost. We utilize the closed form Gaussian kernel score for training, which remains defined even for degenerate covariances and admits bounded gradients during optimization. We characterize kernel scores under invertible transforms and prove exact invariance under unitary transforms. At population level, our two-level objective recovers the true marginals and projects the target correlation onto the representable class; finite-sample PAC bounds show that the errors of the two stages enter additively. We evaluate our model on a variety of tasks with a commonly assumed Gaussian domain: Time-series forecasting, monocular depth estimation, and spatial weather prediction, showing improved performance at lower computational cost.
papers.title_cn: SCORE: 多元高斯分布的谱相关估计
papers.abs_cn: 基于神经网络的预测建模在处理高维结构化高斯目标时，需要一种高效、数值稳定且具有表达能力的协方差矩阵近似方法。我们提出 SCORE：一个可扩展框架，将评分规则训练与在谱空间中学习到的具有表达能力的协方差近似相结合。对于 d 维数据，学习任务被分解为学习边缘分布和学习结构化相关矩阵，从而在实现稠密依赖关系的同时保持线性存储和 O(d log d) 的计算成本。我们利用高斯核评分的闭式形式进行训练，该评分即使在退化协方差下仍有定义，并且在优化过程中具有有界梯度。我们刻画了可逆变换下的核评分，并证明了在酉变换下的精确不变性。在总体层面，我们的两级目标能够恢复真实的边缘分布，并将目标相关投影到可表示类上；有限样本 PAC 界表明两个阶段的误差以加性方式进入。我们在通常假设为高斯域的多种任务上评估了我们的模型：时间序列预测、单目深度估计和空间天气预测，结果表明在更低计算成本下性能有所提升。

papers.title: DVLA-RL++: Dual-Level Vision-Language Alignment with Reinforcement Learning Gating for Few-Shot Learning
papers.abstract: Few-shot learning aims to recognize novel categories from limited labeled examples. Recent studies incorporate textual semantics to compensate for limited visual observations and improve class representations. However, high image-text agreement may reflect both intrinsic object properties and incidental context, making support prototypes susceptible to contextual contamination. To address this problem, we propose DVLA-RL++, which extends DVLA-RL with complementary semantic purification (CSP) and counterfactual reinforcement-learning gating (CRG). Specifically, CSP generates intrinsic and nuisance descriptions from labeled supports and compares their agreement with each support token. An ambiguity-dependent rejection margin guides sparse evidence allocation, while an intrinsic semantic anchor fills the unassigned mass to provide a fallback when visual evidence is unreliable. CRG learns layer-wise semantic fusion strengths using a reward that balances recognition performance and nuisance exposure. An independently executed reference trajectory on the same episode provides a paired learning signal. Theoretical analysis relates retained evidence and anchor quality to prototype stability and establishes conditions for unbiased on-policy gradient estimation. Experiments on standard, fine-grained, and cross-domain benchmarks show state-of-the-art accuracy, with an average gain of 1.4% over DVLA-RL. The project page is available at https://peacelwh.github.io/TPAMI27-DVLA-RLpp/.
papers.title_cn: DVLA-RL++：基于强化学习门控的双层视觉-语言对齐用于小样本学习
papers.abs_cn: 小样本学习旨在从有限的标注样本中识别新类别。近期研究引入文本语义以补偿有限的视觉观测并改进类别表示。然而，高的图文一致性可能同时反映物体的内在属性和偶然上下文，使得支持原型容易受到上下文污染。为解决这一问题，我们提出 DVLA-RL++，它在 DVLA-RL 的基础上扩展了互补语义净化（CSP）和反事实强化学习门控（CRG）。具体而言，CSP 从标注支持样本中生成内在描述和干扰描述，并比较它们与每个支持 token 的一致性。一个依赖于歧义性的拒绝边际引导稀疏证据分配，而内在语义锚点填充未分配的质量，以在视觉证据不可靠时提供回退。CRG 使用平衡识别性能和干扰暴露的奖励来学习逐层语义融合强度。在同一 episode 上独立执行的参考轨迹提供配对学习信号。理论分析将保留证据和锚点质量与原型稳定性联系起来，并建立了无偏 on-policy 梯度估计的条件。在标准、细粒度和跨域基准上的实验显示了最先进的准确率，相比 DVLA-RL 平均提升 1.4%。项目页面见 https://peacelwh.github.io/TPAMI27-DVLA-RLpp/。

papers.title: Differentiable Systematic Resampling for Variational Sequential Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: Particle filters are a standard tool for nonlinear state estimation, but their resampling step is discrete, preventing gradient-based learning in variational sequential Monte Carlo. We introduce Differentiable Systematic Resampling (DSR), a temperature-controlled relaxation of systematic resampling, that preserves the CDF-ordered, banded structure of systematic resampling while enabling full gradient flow. DSR converges to exact systematic resampling as the temperature vanishes, and we prove a pointwise exponential convergence rate for the induced bias. Compared to optimal-transport-based differentiable resampling, DSR avoids iterative solvers and has substantially lower computational overhead. Experiments on stochastic dynamical systems and real-world handwriting data show that DSR achieves comparable or superior filtering and dynamics learning performance.
papers.title_cn: 用于变分序贯蒙特卡洛的可微系统重采样
papers.abs_cn: 粒子滤波器是非线性状态估计的标准工具，但其重采样步骤是离散的，阻碍了变分序贯蒙特卡洛中基于梯度的学习。我们引入了可微系统重采样（DSR），这是一种系统重采样的温度控制松弛方法，在保持系统重采样的 CDF 有序带状结构的同时实现了完整的梯度流。当温度趋于零时，DSR 收敛到精确的系统重采样，我们证明了所诱导偏差的逐点指数收敛速率。与基于最优传输的可微重采样相比，DSR 避免了迭代求解器，计算开销显著更低。在随机动力系统和真实手写数据上的实验表明，DSR 达到了相当或更优的滤波和动力学学习性能。

papers.title: Recompose and Refine Latent Reasoning Flows for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Latent reasoning enables vision-language-action (VLA) models to transform multimodal observations into task-relevant internal states before generating continuous robot actions. While existing methods learn to generate or refine such states for each policy query, they discard successful reasoning after execution and therefore reconstruct similar computation from scratch. We present Reasoning and Flow Memory (FLOWMEM), a unified VLA model that turns successful latent computation into reusable reasoning experience. Rather than appending a fixed retrieved context, FLOWMEM dynamically retrieves and recomposes compatible latent fragments as the embodied context evolves, forming a reasoning route that follows the temporal structure and progress of successful computation. The route is then refined using current visual and proprioceptive evidence before it conditions action generation. Experiments on RoboMME and LIBERO-Plus show that FLOWMEM attains 48.0% and 77.3% success, outperforming memory-free policies by 1.7 and 4.1 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate the value of reusing successful latent computation for closed-loop VLA control.
papers.title_cn: 为视觉-语言-动作模型重组与精炼潜在推理流
papers.abs_cn: 潜在推理使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够在生成连续机器人动作之前，将多模态观测转化为与任务相关的内部状态。尽管现有方法学习为每个策略查询生成或精炼此类状态，但它们在执行后丢弃成功的推理，因而需要从头重建相似的计算。我们提出推理与流记忆（FLOWMEM），一种统一的 VLA 模型，将成功的潜在计算转化为可复用的推理经验。FLOWMEM 并非附加固定的检索上下文，而是随着具身上下文的演化，动态检索并重组兼容的潜在片段，形成一条遵循成功计算的时间结构与进程的推理路径。随后，该路径在用于条件化动作生成之前，会利用当前视觉与本体感受证据进行精炼。在 RoboMME 和 LIBERO-Plus 上的实验表明，FLOWMEM 分别达到 48.0% 和 77.3% 的成功率，比无记忆策略高出 1.7 和 4.1 个百分点。这些结果证明了复用成功潜在计算对于闭环 VLA 控制的价值。

papers.title: EvoAlloc: A Self-Evolving Resource Allocation Agent for Efficient Program Evolution
papers.abstract: LLM-based program evolution relies on evaluation feedback to guide the iterative search for high-performing programs. However, evaluation is often computationally expensive, making it essential to allocate limited resources to candidates that can most effectively advance the search. Existing LLM-based methods typically rely on fixed allocation strategies throughout the search, potentially wasting resources on low-value candidates while overlooking promising ones. We propose EvoAlloc, a self-evolving resource-allocation agent that learns from search experience to revise its strategy for allocating computational resources across candidates. EvoAlloc periodically consolidates prior search and allocation outcomes into reusable experience, which informs subsequent strategy revisions. It further uses a counterfactual exploration mechanism to occasionally evaluate candidates denied resources by the allocator, revealing their outcomes to enrich its experience for future strategy updates. Across coding and agent-harness optimization benchmarks, EvoAlloc requires 59-82% fewer full evaluations and 61-89% fewer total LLM tokens to reach baseline-level performance. Moreover, under the same full-evaluation budget, EvoAlloc achieves 8.7-12.0% higher final performance.
papers.title_cn: EvoAlloc：一种用于高效程序进化的自进化资源分配智能体
papers.abs_cn: 基于LLM的程序进化依赖评估反馈来引导对高性能程序的迭代搜索。然而，评估通常计算开销高昂，因此必须将有限资源分配给最能有效推进搜索的候选程序。现有的基于LLM的方法通常在整个搜索过程中依赖固定的分配策略，可能将资源浪费在低价值候选程序上，同时忽视有潜力的候选程序。我们提出EvoAlloc，一种自进化的资源分配智能体，它从搜索经验中学习，以修正其在候选程序之间分配计算资源的策略。EvoAlloc定期将先前的搜索和分配结果整合为可复用的经验，为后续策略修正提供依据。它进一步使用反事实探索机制，偶尔评估被分配器拒绝给予资源的候选程序，揭示其结果以丰富自身经验，用于未来的策略更新。在编码和agent-harness优化基准上，EvoAlloc达到基线水平性能所需的完整评估次数减少59-82%，总LLM token数减少61-89%。此外，在相同的完整评估预算下，EvoAlloc的最终性能提高8.7-12.0%。

papers.title: Is Memorization Context-Sensitive? Prefix-Based Extraction Beyond Isolated Prefixes
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can expose memorized training sequences under prefix-based extraction: given a prefix from a training example, the model may assign high probability to the original continuation. In deployed systems, however, prefixes are rarely evaluated in isolation. They often appear together with instructions, retrieved documents, or other task-specific context, as in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This motivates examining whether contextual conditioning mitigates memorization or merely changes the set of memorized samples that become extractable. We investigate this issue through paired item-level measurements of probabilistic suffix extraction. For each prefix-suffix pair, we score the target suffix under an empty prompt and under retrieved contexts of varying relevance, across three open-weight instruction-tuned models. We find that context does not simply erase memorization. Instead, extractable memorization consists of a context-robust core and a context-sensitive boundary. Many samples that are extractable without context remain extractable under the retrieved context, especially as the prefix length increases. At the same time, context mainly affects marginal samples near the extraction threshold: it suppresses some exposures, but also enables new ones that are missed by prefix-only evaluation. These findings qualify the view that RAG reduces memorization risk. Context can lower aggregate extraction by suppressing boundary cases, yet robustly extractable samples persist, and context-enabled extractability remains security-relevant.
papers.title_cn: 记忆是上下文敏感的吗？超越孤立前缀的基于前缀的提取
papers.abs_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在基于前缀的提取下可能暴露记忆的训练序列：给定训练样本中的一个前缀，模型可能对原始续写赋予高概率。然而，在部署系统中，前缀很少被孤立地评估。它们通常与指令、检索文档或其他任务特定上下文一起出现，如在检索增强生成（RAG）中。这促使我们考察上下文条件化是减轻了记忆，还是仅仅改变了可被提取的记忆样本集合。我们通过配对的项目级概率后缀提取测量来研究这一问题。对于每个前缀-后缀对，我们在空提示和不同相关性的检索上下文下对目标后缀进行评分，涵盖三个开放权重的指令微调模型。我们发现上下文并不会简单地消除记忆。相反，可提取的记忆由一个上下文鲁棒的核心和一个上下文敏感的边界组成。许多在无上下文时可提取的样本在检索上下文下仍然可提取，尤其是随着前缀长度的增加。同时，上下文主要影响接近提取阈值的边缘样本：它抑制了一些暴露，但也使仅前缀评估所遗漏的新暴露成为可能。这些发现对RAG降低记忆风险的观点提出了限定。上下文可以通过抑制边界情况来降低总体提取率，但鲁棒可提取的样本仍然存在，且上下文使能的提取性仍具有安全相关性。

papers.title: All Verdicts are Not Equal: Rethinking LLM Judge Reliability
papers.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge is the standard paradigm for NLP evaluation, yet its systemic reliability remains poorly understood despite being widely treated as a deterministic ground truth. We present a comprehensive reliability audit, stresstesting six frontier models across four benchmarks, five prompt formats, two presentation orders, three sampling temperatures, and ten repetitions per condition. Our empirical analysis reveals severe vulnerabilities: verdicts change across identical replications at temperature zero, position-order swaps flip the majority of verdicts on challenging tasks, and the most deterministic judge achieves perfect consistency by trivially repeating incorrect verdicts, agreeing with ground truth only 51% of the time. To formalize these multi-faceted failure modes, we introduce the trustworthy verdict rate (T ), a unified metric capturing the joint probability that an evaluation is reproducible, order-invariant, and accurate. UsingT , we derive a theoretical upper bound on accuracy imposed by position bias and show that reliability is item-specific rather than modellevel. Finally, we demonstrate that shifting from pairwise win-rate to holistic rubric scoring improves trustworthiness more than any single-format prompting intervention, offering an actionable framework for robust NLP evaluation.
papers.title_cn: 并非所有判定都生而平等：重新思考LLM评判者的可靠性
papers.abs_cn: LLM-as-a-Judge是NLP评估的标准范式，但其系统性可靠性仍然鲜为人知，尽管它被广泛视为确定性的真实基准。我们提出了一项全面的可靠性审计，对六个前沿模型在四个基准、五种提示格式、两种呈现顺序、三种采样温度以及每种条件十次重复下进行了压力测试。我们的实证分析揭示了严重的脆弱性：在温度为零时，判定在完全相同的重复中发生变化；位置顺序交换会在困难任务上翻转大多数判定；最具确定性的评判者通过简单地重复错误判定来实现完美一致性，与真实基准的一致率仅为51%。为了形式化这些多方面的失败模式，我们引入了可信判定率（T），这是一个统一指标，捕捉评估可复现、顺序不变且准确的联合概率。利用T，我们推导出位置偏差所施加的准确率理论上界，并表明可靠性是项目特定的而非模型级别的。最后，我们证明从成对胜率转向整体评分标准评分比任何单一格式的提示干预都更能提升可信度，为稳健的NLP评估提供了一个可操作的框架。

papers.title: Perception Test 2026: Challenge Summary and Extension to City-scale Audio-Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract: Continuing the Perception Test challenge series, we organised the fourth edition as a workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026 in Malmö, Sweden. This edition focused on spatial intelligence and featured four different tracks: unified multiple-choice videoQA and grounded videoQA from the original Perception Test benchmark, alongside two new tracks based on city-scale walking-tour videos (KilometerAudio and KilometerVision). In this report, we describe the new benchmarks used for the city-scale tracks and summarise the winning solutions across all tracks, including a generalist model that competed across all tracks with satisfactory performance. The winning solutions in the newly added city-scale tracks demonstrated that complex spatial and multimodal reasoning can be solved by expensive agentic pipelines, but remains difficult for multimodal models used standalone.
papers.title_cn: Perception Test 2026：挑战赛总结与向城市尺度音视频推理的扩展
papers.abs_cn: 延续 Perception Test 挑战赛系列，我们在瑞典马尔默举办的 European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026 上组织了第四届研讨会。本届聚焦空间智能，设有四个不同赛道：来自原始 Perception Test 基准的统一多项选择 videoQA 和 grounded videoQA，以及两个基于城市尺度步行游览视频的新赛道（KilometerAudio 和 KilometerVision）。在本报告中，我们描述了用于城市尺度赛道的新基准，并总结了所有赛道的获胜方案，包括一个在所有赛道中参赛并取得令人满意表现的通用模型。新增城市尺度赛道中的获胜方案表明，复杂的空间和多模态推理可以通过昂贵的 agentic 流水线解决，但对于单独使用的多模态模型而言仍然困难。

papers.title: Exploiting Gradients in Bayesian Inference of Expensive Simulators
papers.abstract: Simulators based on differential equations are ubiquitous in science and engineering. They are often used in simulation-based inference to evaluate the posterior distribution of the input parameters based on real-world observations of the simulator outputs. However, inference becomes challenging when individual simulator evaluations are computationally expensive. In such cases, a Bayesian optimization-based active learning approach with Gaussian process surrogate models has been used to maximize the information obtained from a limited simulation budget. Recently, gradients of simulator outputs with respect to input parameters have become increasingly available, yet they are rarely exploited for inference. Even though we only need to learn the simulator input-output relationship, gradient information can provide an additional valuable signal to guide the active learning procedure. This is of particular interest in the case of expensive simulators, when sample efficiency is crucial. In this paper, we demonstrate how incorporating gradient information into the Gaussian process surrogate accelerates Bayesian optimization-based inference under a limited simulation budget. Our results show significant improvement in convergence speed from using gradient information. For reverse-mode differentiation, the inference efficiency gains are maintained when accounting for the additional computational cost. In contrast, for forward-mode differentiation, the inference speed-up does not outweigh the computational costs. These results indicate that gradient-enhanced surrogates are beneficial primarily in problems where the number of parameters exceeds the output dimensionality, where reverse-mode differentiation is efficient.
papers.title_cn: 利用梯度进行昂贵模拟器的贝叶斯推断
papers.abs_cn: 基于微分方程的模拟器在科学与工程中无处不在。它们常用于基于模拟的推断，以根据对模拟器输出的实际观测来评估输入参数的后验分布。然而，当单个模拟器评估的计算成本很高时，推断就变得具有挑战性。在这种情况下，人们使用基于贝叶斯优化的主动学习方法，结合高斯过程代理模型，以在有限的模拟预算下最大化所获得的信息。近年来，模拟器输出相对于输入参数的梯度越来越容易获得，但它们很少被用于推断。尽管我们只需要学习模拟器的输入-输出关系，梯度信息仍可以提供额外的有价值信号来指导主动学习过程。这在昂贵模拟器的情况下尤其有意义，因为此时样本效率至关重要。在本文中，我们展示了将梯度信息纳入高斯过程代理模型如何加速在有限模拟预算下基于贝叶斯优化的推断。我们的结果表明，使用梯度信息在收敛速度上有显著提升。对于反向模式微分，在计入额外计算成本后，推断效率的提升仍然保持。相比之下，对于前向模式微分，推断速度的提升无法抵消计算成本。这些结果表明，梯度增强代理模型主要适用于参数数量超过输出维度的问题，在这种情况下反向模式微分是高效的。

papers.title: A Minimal Optical-Flow Representation for Vision-Based Tactile Rotation Classification in Robotic Manipulation Across Gravity Domains
papers.abstract: Vision-based tactile sensors provide rich contact information, but processing high-resolution images can be costly for resource-constrained platforms such as space robots. This work investigates whether a compact representation of tactile motion can classify object rotation across different gravity conditions. Dense optical flow from a simulated GelSight Mini is aggregated over a 7x9 grid into 126 features and used to classify the direction of load-induced rotation under Earth, Mars, Moon, and orbital gravity. Gravity causes a small but significant shift in these features, accounting for 1.6% of their variance (R2 = 0.016). Despite its small magnitude, this shift affects models trained only on Earth data: XGBoost accuracy decreases from 94.4% on Earth to 75.9% in orbit. In contrast, a single model trained across all four gravity domains achieves 96.3% overall accuracy and 95.1%-97.0% across individual domains, without using gravity as an input. The representation can also be reduced to 40 features while retaining 95.7% accuracy, with XGBoost requiring only 0.14 ms per inference. These findings show that Earth-gravity performance alone is insufficient to establish the transferability of tactile perception for space robotic manipulation, highlighting the need to account for gravity-induced domain shifts during training and validation.
papers.title_cn: 面向跨重力域机器人操作中基于视觉的触觉旋转分类的极简光流表示
papers.abs_cn: 基于视觉的触觉传感器可提供丰富的接触信息，但处理高分辨率图像对于空间机器人等资源受限平台而言可能代价高昂。本文研究触觉运动的紧凑表示能否在不同重力条件下对物体旋转进行分类。来自模拟 GelSight Mini 的稠密光流被聚合到 7x9 网格中形成 126 个特征，并用于在地球、火星、月球和轨道重力下对载荷诱导旋转的方向进行分类。重力会导致这些特征发生小而显著的变化，占其方差的 1.6%（R2 = 0.016）。尽管幅度很小，这种变化会影响仅在地球数据上训练的模型：XGBoost 的准确率从地球上的 94.4% 降至轨道上的 75.9%。相比之下，一个在全部四个重力域上训练的单一模型无需将重力作为输入，即可达到 96.3% 的总体准确率，以及各单独域上 95.1%-97.0% 的准确率。该表示还可缩减至 40 个特征，同时保持 95.7% 的准确率，且 XGBoost 每次推理仅需 0.14 ms。这些发现表明，仅凭地球重力下的性能不足以确立触觉感知在空间机器人操作中的可迁移性，凸显了在训练和验证过程中考虑重力诱导域偏移的必要性。

papers.title: LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes
papers.abstract: Realistic household simulation must capture not only diverse environments but also the lived-in object arrangements and spatial constraints that shape robot motion and interaction. Existing resources often trade off scale, real-world correspondence, and interaction readiness, leaving a gap in faithful, interactive replicas of how real homes are actually arranged. To this end, we introduce LIVIN, a benchmark for spatial and embodied intelligence built on digital twins of 30 diverse lived-in homes. These replicas preserve observed room layouts, furniture configurations, and everyday belongings. To construct them, we design a human-in-the-loop workflow comprising instance recognition, architectural reconstruction, and object generation and placement, with intermediate results reviewed and corrected by humans against the source observations at each stage. We evaluate four tasks in LIVIN: 3D detection, 3D reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation. Our evaluations show that current methods remain challenged by the dense object arrangements, occlusions, limited free space, and constrained interaction regions found in realistic lived-in homes. We hope LIVIN will help advance embodied AI in real-world homes, from spatial understanding to robotic interaction, and ultimately bring embodied intelligence into everyday home environments.
papers.title_cn: LIVIN：在有人居住住宅数字孪生中基准测试空间与具身智能
papers.abs_cn: 真实的家庭模拟不仅需要捕捉多样化的环境，还需要捕捉塑造机器人运动和交互的有人居住物体布局与空间约束。现有资源往往在规模、真实世界对应性和交互就绪性之间取舍，导致在真实住宅实际布置方式的忠实、可交互复刻方面存在空白。为此，我们提出了 LIVIN，一个基于 30 个多样化有人居住住宅数字孪生的空间与具身智能基准。这些复刻保留了观测到的房间布局、家具配置和日常物品。为构建它们，我们设计了一个人在回路工作流，包括实例识别、建筑重建以及物体生成与放置，并在每个阶段由人类对照源观测审查和修正中间结果。我们在 LIVIN 中评估四项任务：3D 检测、3D 重建、导航和移动操作。我们的评估表明，当前方法仍然受到真实有人居住住宅中密集物体布局、遮挡、有限自由空间和受限交互区域的挑战。我们希望 LIVIN 能帮助推进真实世界住宅中的具身 AI，从空间理解到机器人交互，并最终将具身智能带入日常家庭环境。

papers.title: MAST: Motif-Augmented Diffusion with Search Tree for Spectroscopic Molecular Structure Elucidation
papers.abstract: Elucidating molecular structures from spectra is a foundational problem in chemical and materials characterization, yet remains challenging due to spectral ambiguity and the vast molecular space. Although recent diffusion-based generators show strong promise for spectra-conditioned elucidation, existing methods struggle to learn robust spectra-structure relationships from limited paired data when relying solely on global spectral representation. Moreover, the repeated full sampling inference strategy incurs substantial computation overhead. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MAST}, a \textbf{M}otif-\textbf{A}ugmented diffusion framework with \textbf{S}earch \textbf{T}ree, for joint 2D-3D spectroscopic molecular structure elucidation. MAST introduces explicit, interpretable \emph{motif priors} as intermediate evidences throughout denoising, reducing conditional ambiguity and facilitating spectra-conditioned optimization. We further cast diffusion sampling as \emph{reward-guided tree search} to prioritize high-reward denoising trajectories, yielding a compact set of spectra-consistent candidates under limited budgets. On the QM9S multi-spectra benchmark, MAST achieves \textbf{94.89\%} exact recovery and improves 3D fidelity, while preserving high chemical validity and stability. Code is available at https://github.com/Jia040223/MAST.
papers.title_cn: MAST：基于搜索树的基元增强扩散用于光谱分子结构解析
papers.abs_cn: 从光谱中解析分子结构是化学和材料表征中的一个基础问题，但由于光谱模糊性和巨大的分子空间，这一任务仍然具有挑战性。尽管最近的基于扩散的生成器在光谱条件解析方面展现出强大潜力，但现有方法在仅依赖全局光谱表示时，难以从有限的配对数据中学习鲁棒的光谱-结构关系。此外，重复的全采样推理策略会带来大量计算开销。为解决这些局限，我们提出了 MAST，一种带有搜索树的基元增强扩散框架，用于联合 2D-3D 光谱分子结构解析。MAST 在去噪过程中引入显式、可解释的基元先验作为中间证据，从而减少条件模糊性并促进光谱条件优化。我们进一步将扩散采样转化为奖励引导的树搜索，以优先选择高奖励的去噪轨迹，在有限预算下生成一小组与光谱一致的候选结构。在 QM9S 多光谱基准上，MAST 实现了 94.89% 的精确恢复率，并提升了 3D 保真度，同时保持较高的化学有效性和稳定性。代码见 https://github.com/Jia040223/MAST。

papers.title: FTN Signaling: Spectral Efficiency from BPSK to 16-QAM
papers.abstract: Faster-than-Nyquist (FTN) signaling can improve spectral efficiency by transmitting symbols closer together than the Nyquist limit, at the cost of additional inter-symbol interference (ISI). In this letter, we study the finite-alphabet symbol-wise achievable information rate (AIR) of FTN signaling for BPSK, QPSK, and 16-QAM under a transmit-power constraint and a common minimum mean square error (MMSE) channel-shortening (CS) detection framework, cross-validated for BPSK against an independent reduced-state Ungerboeck Bahl-Cocke-Jelinek-Raviv (BCJR) benchmark. Our results show a clear trend. Lower-order constellations can benefit from more aggressive time acceleration, while higher-order constellations become less tolerant of acceleration and achieve their best spectral efficiency closer to the Nyquist limit. At a reference signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of 6 dB the optimum acceleration factor shifts from $τ^\star\approx0.65$ for BPSK to 0.75 for QPSK and 0.90 for 16-QAM. We further show that this trend is preserved in coded systems and remains robust to the detector memory. The impact of FTN operation on the instantaneous-to-average power ratio (IAPR) is also examined. Overall, the results highlight how constellation order should be considered when selecting the operating point for FTN signaling.
papers.title_cn: FTN 信号传输：从 BPSK 到 16-QAM 的频谱效率
papers.abs_cn: 超奈奎斯特（FTN）信号传输通过以比奈奎斯特极限更近的间隔发送符号来提高频谱效率，代价是额外的符号间干扰（ISI）。本文研究了在发射功率约束和统一的 MMSE 信道缩短（CS）检测框架下，FTN 信号传输在 BPSK、QPSK 和 16-QAM 下的有限字母表逐符号可达信息速率（AIR），并针对 BPSK 与独立的减少状态 Ungerboeck BCJR 基准进行了交叉验证。结果表明了一个清晰的趋势：低阶星座可以从更激进的时间加速中获益，而高阶星座对加速的容忍度较低，其最佳频谱效率更接近奈奎斯特极限。在 6 dB 的参考信噪比（SNR）下，最优加速因子从 BPSK 的 τ* ≈ 0.65 偏移到 QPSK 的 0.75 和 16-QAM 的 0.90。我们进一步表明，这一趋势在编码系统中得以保持，并且对检测器记忆长度具有鲁棒性。本文还考察了 FTN 操作对瞬时平均功率比（IAPR）的影响。总体而言，这些结果凸显了在选择 FTN 信号传输工作点时应考虑星座阶数。

papers.title: ILM: An AI-Powered Storytelling Educational Tool
papers.abstract: Digital technologies have made Islamic narratives more accessible, but existing platforms provide limited support for structured learning and comprehension of these stories, particularly in Arabic and multilingual settings. We present ILM, an interactive educational platform for Stories of the Prophets that combines Arabic natural language processing, structured knowledge representation, and retrieval-based question generation. Admin-approved Arabic narratives are processed by a Knowledge Graph (KG) Constructor Engine that identifies entities and narrative relationships and stores them as structured knowledge, enabling learners to explore stories through a visual story map and answer entity- and relation-based questions generated from the KG. Separately, a multilingual retrieval pipeline retrieves relevant passages from the original narratives to generate multiple-choice and open-ended comprehension questions. For open-ended questions, an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluates learners' answers against the retrieved passages and reference answers to determine correctness. The platform also incorporates Quranic content as a separate enrichment layer, allowing selected narratives to be supplemented with source-supported information. By combining structured knowledge with passage-based retrieval, ILM supports narrative exploration, comprehension, and assessment across Arabic and multilingual content. The system demonstrates the feasibility of combining structured knowledge representation and retrieval-based generation to support interactive learning of Islamic narratives. A demo is available at anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF.
papers.title_cn: ILM：一款AI驱动的故事教学工具
papers.abs_cn: 数字技术使伊斯兰叙事更易获取，但现有平台对这些故事的结构化学习和理解支持有限，尤其是在阿拉伯语和多语言环境中。我们提出ILM，一个面向先知故事的互动教育平台，结合了阿拉伯语自然语言处理、结构化知识表示和基于检索的问题生成。管理员审核通过的阿拉伯语叙事由知识图谱（KG）构建引擎处理，该引擎识别实体和叙事关系并将其存储为结构化知识，使学习者能够通过可视化故事地图探索故事，并回答由KG生成的基于实体和关系的问题。另外，一个多语言检索流水线从原始叙事中检索相关段落，以生成多项选择和开放式理解问题。对于开放式问题，LLM-as-a-Judge根据检索到的段落和参考答案评估学习者的答案以判定正确性。该平台还将古兰经内容作为单独的增强层，允许选定的叙事补充有来源支持的信息。通过将结构化知识与基于段落的检索相结合，ILM支持阿拉伯语和多语言内容的叙事探索、理解和评估。该系统展示了结合结构化知识表示和基于检索的生成来支持伊斯兰叙事互动学习的可行性。演示见anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF。

papers.title: When Should Agents Think? Adaptive Reasoning via Cross-Turn Estimation
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities on complex tasks. They typically perform reasoning before each action throughout an interaction trajectory. However, reasoning may not be necessary at every turn, as reasoning produced earlier can continue to support subsequent actions. A key challenge is therefore to determine when existing reasoning remains sufficient and when a new reasoning step is needed, without relying on costly generation-based verification. We find that decreases in the likelihood of subsequent reference actions after removing additional reasoning closely track whether those actions remain recoverable given earlier reasoning, providing an effective and lightweight signal for estimating cross-turn action support. Based on this observation, we propose Reasoning Adaptation through Cross-Turn Estimation (RACE), a training approach for adaptive agent reasoning. RACE introduces a Likelihood-Guided Progressive Reasoning Cover Detection (LoGiC) procedure that progressively identifies reasoning turns whose removal has limited impact on the current and subsequent reference actions. The resulting removal signals are incorporated into both supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning, enabling the policy to learn when to reason and when to act directly. Extensive experiments on four representative agent benchmarks show that RACE substantially reduces reasoning cost while maintaining or improving task performance.
papers.title_cn: 智能体何时应当思考？通过跨轮次估计实现自适应推理
papers.abs_cn: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在复杂任务上已展现出强大能力。它们通常在整个交互轨迹中的每个动作之前都进行推理。然而，并非每一轮都需要推理，因为先前产生的推理可以继续支持后续动作。因此，一个关键挑战是确定现有推理何时仍然充分、何时需要新的推理步骤，同时不依赖代价高昂的基于生成的验证。我们发现，在移除额外推理后，后续参考动作的似然下降，与这些动作在给定早期推理时是否仍然可恢复密切相关，从而为估计跨轮次动作支持提供了一种有效且轻量的信号。基于这一观察，我们提出了通过跨轮次估计实现推理自适应（RACE），一种用于自适应智能体推理的训练方法。RACE 引入了一种似然引导的渐进式推理覆盖检测（LoGiC）过程，该过程逐步识别那些移除后对当前及后续参考动作影响有限的推理轮次。由此得到的移除信号被纳入监督微调和智能体强化学习中，使策略能够学习何时推理、何时直接行动。在四个代表性智能体基准上的大量实验表明，RACE 在保持或提升任务性能的同时，大幅降低了推理成本。

papers.title: Look Back, Think Ahead: Visual Memory on Demand for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract: Processing long visual token sequences from high-resolution images makes multi-step reasoning computationally expensive for multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing one-shot pruning and aggregation methods compress visual tokens into a fixed context before decoding. However, visual evidence needs can shift as reasoning unfolds, making it difficult for a fixed compressed context to retain all the details needed across stages. To address this challenge, we propose ViMoD, a lightweight framework that maintains a compact visual context while preserving access to original fine-grained evidence as reasoning needs evolve. Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens (DART) learns content-adaptive groups and aggregation capacities, constructing compact Coarse representations linked to recoverable original Fine tokens. Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence (TRACE) integrates decoding history to anticipate upcoming evidence needs and select, retain, or replace active Fine-token groups. Selected Fine tokens augment the persistent Coarse context in the frozen backbone, enabling stage-specific evidence access without continuously attending to all visual tokens. On Qwen3-VL-4B, ViMoD outperforms all evaluated baselines on all eight reasoning benchmarks at a 20% target visual token budget, improving the mean normalized score by 39.0% over the strongest evaluated one-shot baseline. These gains are achieved with only 0.0546% additional trainable parameters relative to the frozen backbone.
papers.title_cn: 回望过去，前瞻未来：按需视觉记忆实现高效多模态推理
papers.abs_cn: 处理来自高分辨率图像的长视觉 token 序列会使多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的多步推理计算代价高昂。现有的一次性剪枝与聚合方法在解码前将视觉 token 压缩为固定上下文。然而，视觉证据需求会随着推理的展开而变化，使得固定的压缩上下文难以保留各阶段所需的全部细节。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 ViMoD，一个轻量级框架，它在保持紧凑视觉上下文的同时，随着推理需求的变化保留对原始细粒度证据的访问能力。区域 token 可变形聚合（DART）学习内容自适应的分组与聚合能力，构建紧凑的 Coarse 表示，并链接到可恢复的原始 Fine token。自适应上下文证据的时间路由（TRACE）整合解码历史以预测即将到来的证据需求，并选择、保留或替换活跃的 Fine token 组。选中的 Fine token 在冻结主干中增强持久的 Coarse 上下文，从而实现阶段特定的证据访问，而无需持续关注所有视觉 token。在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上，ViMoD 在 20% 目标视觉 token 预算下，在全部八个推理基准上优于所有评估基线，相比最强的评估一次性基线，平均归一化分数提升 39.0%。这些增益仅需相对于冻结主干 0.0546% 的额外可训练参数。

papers.title: Structure Tax: How Structured Output affects LLMs Performance
papers.abstract: Deploying large language models in production often requires constraining outputs to structured formats such as JSON or XML, and prior work treats the resulting accuracy loss as an inherent `structure tax'. We re-examine this claim by evaluating a battery of models, datasets and schemas, measuring task accuracy, confidence calibration, and hidden-state geometry. The tax turns out to depend on schema design rather than on structure per se: reasoning-first field ordering matches or exceeds free-form accuracy, while answer-first ordering causes steep drops, particularly in smaller models. Format sensitivity scales inversely with a task's own structural constraints, and schemas that preserve reasoning order also improve calibration with CKA showing greater separability between correct and incorrect representations in middle transformer layers. Our findings indicate that properly designed structured formats can match or exceed free-form performance, reframing the critical question from `whether to structure' to `how to structure' for optimal reasoning preservation.
papers.title_cn: 结构税：结构化输出如何影响大语言模型性能
papers.abs_cn: 在生产环境中部署大语言模型通常需要将输出约束为 JSON 或 XML 等结构化格式，此前的工作将由此产生的准确率损失视为一种固有的“结构税”。我们通过评估一系列模型、数据集和模式，测量任务准确率、置信度校准和隐藏状态几何，重新审视了这一论断。结果表明，这种税取决于模式设计而非结构本身：推理优先的字段顺序能够匹配或超过自由形式的准确率，而答案优先的顺序则会导致准确率急剧下降，在较小模型中尤为明显。格式敏感性与任务自身的结构约束呈反向关系，且保留推理顺序的模式还能改善校准，CKA 显示在 transformer 中间层中正确与错误表示之间具有更大的可分性。我们的发现表明，经过恰当设计的结构化格式可以匹配或超过自由形式的性能，从而将关键问题从“是否要结构化”重新定义为“如何结构化”以最优地保留推理。

papers.title: Diffusion Removes Langevin's Conditioning Dependence: A Sharp Gaussian Analysis
papers.abstract: Despite their empirical success, why diffusion models overcome the bottlenecks of classical score-based samplers remains unclear. In this work, we leverage Gaussian distributions to isolate this phenomenon. We establish 2-Wasserstein convergence bounds for optimized hyperparameters, showing that diffusion processes achieve a sampling error of $O(\sqrt{dλ_{\max}}\log N/N)$, where $d$ is the dimension, $N$ the number of sampling steps, and $λ_{\max}$ the largest eigenvalue of the target covariance matrix. Unadjusted and underdamped Langevin dynamics suffer from an additional $\sqrtκ$ factor, where $κ$ is the condition number. These rates follow from spectral bounds which are sharp: we confirm them via matching first-order asymptotics as $N\rightarrow\infty$. Our analysis provides a rigorous characterization, in the Gaussian setting, of how time-dependent score trajectories remove condition-number dependence during sampling. By contrast, in the learning phase, we show that estimating the unnoised score by gradient descent leads to essentially the same estimator as estimating a noisy score, which suggests that the benefits of noising do not come from the learning phase.
papers.title_cn: 扩散消除了 Langevin 的条件数依赖：一个精确的高斯分析
papers.abs_cn: 尽管扩散模型在经验上取得了成功，但为什么它们能克服经典基于分数的采样器的瓶颈仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们利用高斯分布来分离这一现象。我们为优化超参数建立了 2-Wasserstein 收敛界，表明扩散过程达到了 O(sqrt(d lambda_max) log N / N) 的采样误差，其中 d 是维度，N 是采样步数，lambda_max 是目标协方差矩阵的最大特征值。未调整和欠阻尼 Langevin 动力学则额外承受一个 sqrt(kappa) 因子，其中 kappa 是条件数。这些速率来自精确的谱界：我们通过 N -> infinity 时匹配的一阶渐近性加以确认。我们的分析在高斯设定下严格刻画了时变分数轨迹如何在采样过程中消除条件数依赖。相比之下，在学习阶段，我们表明通过梯度下降估计无噪声分数会得到与估计带噪声分数本质相同的估计量，这表明加噪的好处并非来自学习阶段。

papers.title: Do Not Train Away Uncertainty: Early Uncertainty Anchored Calibration
papers.abstract: Deep neural networks, including large language models, have achieved remarkable performance across various tasks. However, they are prone to overconfidence during training or fine-tuning. In this work, we observe a consistent phenomenon across different models that the early model is better calibrated, while later training or fine-tuning yields marginal accuracy gains but substantially increases calibration errors. Our analysis suggests that the early model retains uncertainty awareness in both its predictions and features, which is gradually lost with continued training. To avoid training away this uncertainty awareness, we propose \textbf{EUA-Cal}, a novel method that exploits the \textbf{E}arly model as an \textbf{U}ncertainty \textbf{A}nchor for \textbf{Cal}ibration. EUA-Cal introduces early prediction regularization to preserve early predictive uncertainty and prototype structure regularization to exploit uncertainty reflected in the early feature space, jointly mitigating overconfidence. Extensive experiments on image classification and multiple-choice question answering across eight diverse models demonstrate that EUA-Cal outperforms state-of-the-art calibration methods.
papers.title_cn: 不要将不确定性训练掉：早期不确定性锚定校准
papers.abs_cn: 深度神经网络，包括大语言模型，在各种任务上取得了显著性能。然而，它们在训练或微调过程中容易过度自信。在这项工作中，我们观察到不同模型间存在一致现象：早期模型校准更好，而后续训练或微调带来边际精度提升却大幅增加校准误差。我们的分析表明，早期模型在其预测和特征中保留了不确定性意识，而随着持续训练这种意识逐渐丧失。为避免将这种不确定性意识训练掉，我们提出 EUA-Cal，一种利用早期模型作为不确定性锚进行校准的新方法。EUA-Cal 引入早期预测正则化以保留早期预测不确定性，并引入原型结构正则化以利用早期特征空间中反映的不确定性，共同缓解过度自信。在八种不同模型上的图像分类和多选题问答的广泛实验表明，EUA-Cal 优于最先进的校准方法。

papers.title: MPGE: A Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer for Molecular Classification Explanation
papers.abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) predict molecular properties from chemical graph data, but predictive accuracy does not explain how graph information supports an individual decision. A compact prediction-preserving rationale does not necessarily reveal which changes reverse the decision or which modifications the model tolerates. We propose the Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer (MPGE), unifying factual support, counterfactual sensitivity, and exemplar tolerance for a frozen classifier. The factual view, originally termed prototype (PT), seeks a compact retained edge set with the same label and required confidence. Counterfactual (CF) explanations seek bounded prediction-changing deletions; exemplar (EXE) explanations seek non-trivial bounded deletions that preserve the label and confidence. A shared constrained formulation connects prediction behavior, compactness, and edit cost, while separate objectives generate the three views. Our graph-classification extension of CF-GNNExplainer learns symmetric edge rankings and verifies discrete candidates, recording unsuccessful searches. A separate BBBP fragment backend returns RDKit-sanitized molecules. We evaluate the primary GCN implementation on MUTAG, Mutagenicity, AIDS, COX2_MD, and BBBP using semantic coverage, conditional quality, stability, and runtime. Successful factual masks retained 8.6%--15.5% of input edges on average across datasets; bounded counterfactual coverage was 4.8%--67.6%, and exemplar preservation coverage was 98.9%--100.0%. Exploratory controls reveal the influence of hard projection and retained node information. Quantitative comparisons and molecular visualizations characterize model support, sensitivity, and tolerance without treating them as validated chemical mechanisms.
papers.title_cn: MPGE：一种用于分子分类解释的多视角图解释器
papers.abs_cn: 图神经网络（GNN）从化学图数据中预测分子性质，但预测准确性并不能解释图信息如何支持单个决策。一个紧凑的保持预测的依据不一定能揭示哪些改变会逆转决策，或模型能容忍哪些修改。我们提出多视角图解释器（MPGE），为冻结的分类器统一了事实支持、反事实敏感性和样例容忍性。事实视角最初称为原型（PT），寻求具有相同标签和所需置信度的紧凑保留边集。反事实（CF）解释寻求有界的、改变预测的删除；样例（EXE）解释寻求保持标签和置信度的非平凡有界删除。一个共享的约束公式连接了预测行为、紧凑性和编辑成本，而各自的目标生成三种视角。我们对 CF-GNNExplainer 的图分类扩展学习对称边排序并验证离散候选，记录不成功的搜索。一个独立的 BBBP 片段后端返回经 RDKit 净化的分子。我们在 MUTAG、Mutagenicity、AIDS、COX2_MD 和 BBBP 上评估主要的 GCN 实现，使用语义覆盖率、条件质量、稳定性和运行时间。成功的 factual 掩码在各数据集上平均保留了输入边的 8.6%--15.5%；有界反事实覆盖率为 4.8%--67.6%，样例保持覆盖率为 98.9%--100.0%。探索性对照揭示了硬投影和保留节点信息的影响。定量比较和分子可视化刻画了模型支持、敏感性和容忍性，但不将其视为经过验证的化学机制。

papers.title: Reputation-Graded Wavelet-Packet Subtree Allocation for IoT Sensor Networks
papers.abstract: Access control in Internet of Things (IoT) sensor networks usually acts above the physical layer: the fusion centre decides which reports to accept, while the radio of a compromised node keeps occupying the shared channel. This paper places the entitlement in the waveform: wavelet packet division multiplexing (WPDM) builds the channel as a binary tree of orthogonal pulses, and each sensor's reputation sets the depth of the subtree it may use: trusted sensors hold wide subbands, and low-trust sensors hold narrow subbands that the fusion centre withdraws one at a time. We prove that the allocation isolates sensors exactly under perfect timing, and that under a timing offset the energy leaking out of the lowpass leaf falls fourfold per tree level. The locally optimum detector of out-of-subtree transmission in impulsive Class-A noise weights each leaf in proportion to this predicted leakage. We bound the time needed to confine a compromised node and derive the optimal tree depth. In simulation, with demoted nodes radiating within their allocation, the scheme lowers the probability of a false global decision by 68% relative to fixed-allocation WPDM and to OFDM with the same reputation tiers, and by 44% relative to cryptographic re-attestation, which leads once more than 24% of the sensors are compromised.
papers.title_cn: 面向物联网传感器网络的声誉分级小波包子树分配
papers.abs_cn: 物联网（IoT）传感器网络中的访问控制通常作用于物理层之上：融合中心决定接受哪些报告，而被攻陷节点的射频仍持续占用共享信道。本文将授权置于波形之中：小波包分割复用（WPDM）将信道构建为正交脉冲的二叉树，每个传感器的声誉决定其可使用的子树深度：可信传感器持有宽子带，低信任传感器持有窄子带，融合中心逐一收回这些窄子带。我们证明，在完美定时下该分配能精确隔离传感器，而在存在定时偏移时，低通叶节点泄漏的能量每提升一个树层级下降四倍。在脉冲性 Class-A 噪声中，对子树外传输的局部最优检测器按该预测泄漏量对每个叶节点加权。我们界定了限制被攻陷节点所需的时间，并推导出最优树深度。在仿真中，当被降级节点在其分配范围内辐射时，相较于固定分配的 WPDM 以及具有相同声誉层级的 OFDM，该方案将错误全局判决概率降低 68%；相较于密码学重认证，在被攻陷传感器比例超过 24% 后，该方案将错误全局判决概率降低 44%。

papers.title: Efficient and Generalizable Archetypal Analysis for Discrete Data
papers.abstract: Archetypal Analysis (AA) represents observations as convex combinations of extremal data-driven profiles, yielding interpretable low-dimensional descriptions of complex datasets. Classical AA relies on a least-squares objective, which is poorly suited to discrete observations such as binary, count, and categorical data. We introduce an efficient likelihood-based framework for AA supporting Bernoulli, Poisson, and multinomial observation models. Our optimization scheme employs local quadratic approximations of the negative log-likelihood, enabling constrained updates through sequential minimal optimization (SMO) and an active-set method. Scalability is improved by bounding the active set while preserving simplex feasibility. We further introduce a cross-validated predictive likelihood criterion for selecting the number of archetypes, providing a principled alternative to reconstruction-error heuristics and stability-based diagnostics. Synthetic experiments demonstrate computational efficiency and accurate recovery of model complexity. Applications to single-cell RNA sequencing, microbiome composition, and somatic mutation data show that the learned archetypes capture interpretable domain-specific structures while achieving competitive likelihood fits and stable solutions. Overall, the proposed framework enables efficient likelihood-based archetypal analysis of discrete data, complemented by predictive likelihood-based model selection.
papers.title_cn: 面向离散数据的高效且可泛化的原型分析
papers.abs_cn: 原型分析（AA）将观测表示为极端数据驱动剖面的凸组合，从而对复杂数据集产生可解释的低维描述。经典 AA 依赖于最小二乘目标，不适合二值、计数和分类等离散观测。我们引入了一个高效、基于似然的 AA 框架，支持 Bernoulli、Poisson 和 multinomial 观测模型。我们的优化方案采用负对数似然的局部二次近似，通过序列最小优化（SMO）和活跃集方法实现约束更新。通过在保持单纯形可行性的同时限制活跃集，可扩展性得到改善。我们进一步引入了一种交叉验证的预测似然准则来选择原型数量，为基于重构误差的启发式方法和基于稳定性的诊断提供了有原则的替代方案。合成实验证明了计算效率和模型复杂度的准确恢复。在单细胞 RNA 测序、微生物组组成和体细胞突变数据上的应用表明，学习到的原型能够捕捉可解释的领域特定结构，同时实现有竞争力的似然拟合和稳定解。总体而言，所提出的框架能够对离散数据进行高效的基于似然的原型分析，并辅以基于预测似然的模型选择。

papers.title: An Improved Upper Bound on the Capacity of the Primitive Diamond Relay Channel
papers.abstract: We study the capacity of the primitive diamond relay channel and derive an improved upper bound compared with existing upper bounds by employing the Csiszár--Körner--Marton sum identity and Gallager-type identification. For Gaussian primitive diamond relay channels, we show that our proposed bound coincides with the existing strengthened Gaussian upper bound of Wu, Özgür, Peleg, and Shamai. For discrete memoryless channels, our bound can be strictly tighter than both the cut-set bound and the existing upper bound, and we assess the improvement using different channel instances, together with a decode--forward/compress--forward time-sharing inner bound.
papers.title_cn: 原始菱形中继信道容量的一个改进上界
papers.abs_cn: 我们研究原始菱形中继信道的容量，并利用 Csiszár--Körner--Marton 和恒等式与 Gallager 型辨识推导出一个相较于现有上界更优的上界。对于高斯原始菱形中继信道，我们证明所提出的界与 Wu、Özgür、Peleg 和 Shamai 已有的强化高斯上界一致。对于离散无记忆信道，我们的界可以严格紧于割集界和现有上界，并且我们使用不同的信道实例评估了这一改进，同时结合了 decode--forward/compress--forward 时分内界。

papers.title: Traceable World State: A Provenance-Aware State Representation and Deterministic Replay Framework for Robotic Systems
papers.abstract: Robotic systems operating over extended tasks must maintain a world state assembled from observations arriving at different times, with varying confidence and potential revisions. Conventional representations emphasize latest estimates, hindering fact provenance, decision reproduction, or execution auditing. We present Traceable World State (TWS), a middleware-neutral semantic representation and reference runtime for provenance-aware robot world state. A TWS snapshot captures entities, relations, observations, confidence, and revision metadata. Validated update operations transform snapshots immutably, ordered updates support deterministic replay, and a canonical SHA-256 hash chain ensures tamper-evident logs. We evaluate TWS through schema conformance, complete state lifecycles, deterministic replay, and fault injection. Passing 38 tests across Python 3.10-3.14, the framework detects record corruptions, broken hash links, sequence discontinuities, and world mismatches. Across ten public BEHAVIOR-1K task definitions, TWS imported 153 entities and 146 relations with successful validation. On 103 NVIDIA Unitree G1 simulated trajectories containing 78,369 frames, TWS achieved exact terminal-state replay in all episodes and detected 412/412 injected corruptions with a 1.72% storage overhead over Plain JSONL.
papers.title_cn: 可追溯世界状态：面向机器人系统的溯源感知状态表示与确定性重放框架
papers.abs_cn: 在长时间任务中运行的机器人系统必须维护一个世界状态，该状态由不同时间到达、具有不同置信度且可能被修订的观测数据组装而成。传统表示方法强调最新估计，阻碍了事实溯源、决策复现或执行审计。我们提出可追溯世界状态（TWS），一种中间件中立的语义表示与参考运行时，用于溯源感知的机器人世界状态。TWS 快照捕获实体、关系、观测、置信度和修订元数据。经过验证的更新操作以不可变方式转换快照，有序更新支持确定性重放，而规范的 SHA-256 哈希链确保日志防篡改。我们通过模式一致性、完整状态生命周期、确定性重放和故障注入来评估 TWS。该框架在 Python 3.10-3.14 上通过 38 项测试，能够检测记录损坏、哈希链接断裂、序列不连续和世界不匹配。在十个公开的 BEHAVIOR-1K 任务定义中，TWS 成功导入并验证了 153 个实体和 146 个关系。在包含 78,369 帧的 103 条 NVIDIA Unitree G1 模拟轨迹上，TWS 在所有回合中实现了精确的终态重放，并以相对于 Plain JSONL 仅 1.72% 的存储开销检测出 412/412 次注入损坏。

papers.title: Natural Language to First-Order Logic LLM-based Autoformalization
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have renewed interest in autoformalization. Yet, when First-Order Logic (FOL) is considered as the target formalism, the field still lacks a unified task formulation and a systematic survey. This paper addresses this gap: we first provide a principled definition for the FOL-autoformalization task by distinguishing Ontology Extraction from Logical Translation, showing how their conflation obscures (cross-study) evaluation; we review existing datasets, evaluation metrics, and LLM-based methods, including fine-tuning, prompting, and verification-based refinement; we identify open challenges in benchmarking, semantic evaluation, ontology-aware methods, and end-to-end applications.
papers.title_cn: 自然语言到一阶逻辑的基于LLM的自动形式化
papers.abs_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）重新激发了人们对自动形式化的兴趣。然而，当以一阶逻辑（FOL）作为目标形式化时，该领域仍然缺乏统一的任务表述和系统性综述。本文填补了这一空白：我们首先通过区分本体提取与逻辑翻译，为FOL自动形式化任务提供了一个有原则的定义，并展示了将二者混为一谈如何模糊了（跨研究的）评估；我们回顾了现有数据集、评估指标和基于LLM的方法，包括微调、提示和基于验证的细化；我们指出了在基准测试、语义评估、本体感知方法和端到端应用方面的开放挑战。

papers.title: Policy Synthesis for Finite Populations of MDP Agents under Aggregate Reach-Avoid Chance Constraints
papers.abstract: Consider a finite population of agents with decoupled Markov transition dynamics and empirical-density feedback, subject to the following constraints: with probability at least $1-δ_r$, at least a fraction $α_r$ of agents must reach a target region at some time $t^*$, while, at each time up to $t^*$, the unsafe population fraction must remain below $β_u$ with probability at least $1-δ_u$. However, standard mean-field methods enforce these constraints only in expectation, which fails to account for stochastic fluctuations at finite fleet size $N$. To address this control problem, we propagate the second-order moment (variance) of the empirical density alongside the mean-field trajectory via a discrete-time Lyapunov recursion, and apply the Cantelli inequality to convert chance constraints into tractable deterministic conditions on the moments of the empirical density. We then incorporate these moment-based surrogate constraints into a gradient-based sequential convex approximation procedure for density-feedback policy synthesis. We further introduce additional moment-error bounds to construct a rigorous finite-$N$ certificate. The method is evaluated on a gridworld environment and a power-system EV-charging aggregation problem and compared with a standard deterministic population-level LP baseline.
papers.title_cn: 聚合可达-避碰机会约束下有限规模MDP智能体群体的策略综合
papers.abs_cn: 考虑一个由解耦马尔可夫转移动态和经验密度反馈驱动的有限智能体群体，受以下约束：以至少 $1-δ_r$ 的概率，至少 $α_r$ 比例的智能体必须在某个时刻 $t^*$ 到达目标区域，同时，在直到 $t^*$ 的每个时刻，不安全群体比例必须以至少 $1-δ_u$ 的概率保持在 $β_u$ 以下。然而，标准的平均场方法仅在期望意义下强制这些约束，无法考虑有限群体规模 $N$ 下的随机波动。为解决这一控制问题，我们通过离散时间Lyapunov递推，在平均场轨迹之外传播经验密度的二阶矩（方差），并应用Cantelli不等式将机会约束转化为关于经验密度矩的可处理确定性条件。然后，我们将这些基于矩的替代约束纳入基于梯度的序列凸近似过程，用于密度反馈策略综合。我们进一步引入额外的矩误差界，以构建严格的有限 $N$ 证书。该方法在网格世界环境和电力系统电动汽车充电聚合问题上进行了评估，并与标准的确定性群体级LP基线进行了比较。

papers.title: Humanoid World Action Model With Joint State--Action Generation
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots are a promising platform for general-purpose manipulation. Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies learn actions directly from multimodal observations, while World Action Models (WAMs) further incorporate future visual prediction to improve action generation. However, in hierarchical humanoid systems, VLA and WAM policies output reference actions that are subsequently realized through whole-body control, robot dynamics, balance, and contact. This hierarchy creates an action--execution gap: the reference produced by the policy can differ from the motion realized by the robot. Without explicitly modeling the realized body state, future visual prediction must jointly explain scene evolution and discrepancies between reference actions and executed motion, making it difficult to associate an action with its physical outcome. We propose HWAM, a Humanoid World Action Model with joint state--action generation, which makes the robot's post-execution proprioceptive state an explicit prediction target. By jointly generating reference actions and their realized body states, HWAM directly incorporates supervision of executed motion into action learning. HWAM is trained through three complementary conditional paths. The Policy path jointly denoises state--action trajectories conditioned only on current observations, matching deployment conditions. Forward Dynamics Modeling (FDM) predicts future visual observations conditioned on actions and post-execution states, while Inverse Dynamics Modeling (IDM) reconstructs the joint trajectory from visual transitions. Together, these paths connect policy references, realized body motion, and visual outcomes. HWAM achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines on three real-robot tasks on the LimX OLI humanoid. On Candy Picking, HWAM achieves a 70.6% success rate, compared with 43.3% for Fast-WAM.
papers.title_cn: 具有联合状态-动作生成的人形世界动作模型
papers.abs_cn: 人形机器人是通用操作中极具前景的平台。近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略直接从多模态观测中学习动作，而世界动作模型（WAM）进一步引入未来视觉预测以改进动作生成。然而，在分层人形系统中，VLA 和 WAM 策略输出参考动作，这些动作随后通过全身控制、机器人动力学、平衡和接触来实现。这种分层结构造成了动作-执行差距：策略产生的参考动作可能与机器人实际实现的运动不同。若不显式建模实际实现的身体状态，未来视觉预测必须同时解释场景演化以及参考动作与执行运动之间的差异，这使得将动作与其物理结果关联起来变得困难。我们提出 HWAM，一种具有联合状态-动作生成的人形世界动作模型，它将机器人执行后的本体感受状态作为显式预测目标。通过联合生成参考动作及其实际实现的身体状态，HWAM 将对执行运动的监督直接纳入动作学习。HWAM 通过三条互补的条件路径进行训练。Policy 路径仅以当前观测为条件，对状态-动作轨迹进行联合去噪，与部署条件相匹配。前向动力学建模（FDM）以动作和执行后状态为条件预测未来视觉观测，而逆向动力学建模（IDM）从视觉转移中重建联合轨迹。这些路径共同连接了策略参考、实际实现的身体运动和视觉结果。在 LimX OLI 人形机器人的三个真实机器人任务上，HWAM 在所评估的基线中取得了最高成功率。在 Candy Picking 任务上，HWAM 取得了 70.6% 的成功率，而 Fast-WAM 为 43.3%。

papers.title: How Do LLMs Change Predictions Under Negation?
papers.abstract: Negation is an essential feature of human language, yet large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable in processing it. We evaluate recent open-source and closed-source LLMs on our negation benchmark and find that, in 37-71% of cases, they repeat the same answer under negation (e.g., "Madrid" for "What is not the capital of Spain?"). To understand and address this brittleness, we mechanistically examine how models operate under negation. Our main finding is that specialized attention heads and MLP neurons jointly implement negation by (1) suppressing retrieval of the original answer (e.g., "Madrid") while (2) promoting a favored candidate within the answer category (e.g., "Paris").
